'''Devlor Samt''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]. While surveying an uninhabited [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Samt's team was attacked by two hostile [[Alien/Legends|aliens]]. Samt's team killed the pair, but found their son nearby. Samt took the child, [[Voegliss]], and raised him as his own son. When Voegliss turned fifteen, the local [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] directed the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] to capture Voegliss to use as a special operative. Voegliss remained loyal to Samt throughout his service.
